Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

Face: long narrow face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; broad low bridge, full lips; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: dark-brown, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: sculpted edge pattern. Wardrobe: apron-workwear-layers, specifically a work shirt, asymmetrical apron layers, reinforced trousers, and sturdy shoes; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette indigo-sand. Visible personal details: a shallow cheek scar; a hand-painted hem mark; a narrow bracelet stack. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: uses small rhythmic repeats of the palette. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a worn spool of colored thread only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
